SELECT tt.* FROM teaching_task tt INNER JOIN course c ON tt.course_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN teacher t ON tt.teacher_id = t.id AND t.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN class_info cl ON tt.class_id = cl.id AND cl.deleted = 0 WHERE tt.deleted = 0
AND tt.status = #{status}
AND c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{teacherName}, '%')
AND cl.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{className}, '%')
AND tt.semester_id = #{semesterId}
ORDER BY tt.create_time DESC

SELECT tt.*, c.course_type AS courseType, t.name AS teacherName, t.status AS teacherStatus, cl.class_name AS className, cl.status AS classStatus, cl.student_count AS studentCount FROM teaching_task tt LEFT JOIN course c ON tt.course_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN teacher t ON tt.teacher_id = t.id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN class_info cl ON tt.class_id = cl.id AND cl.deleted = 0 WHERE tt.id = #{id} AND tt.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
